data.name: Arnaud Thion's Dragons 2
data.detailed_description:
Arnaud Thion’s Dragons 2 expands upon the original cult hit with improved graphics, a gripping narrative, and a new dynamic cinematic camera that plunges you straight into the heart of destruction.

You are not a hero.
You are the dragon — the storm of flame that kingdoms whisper of in fear.
Each level is a deadly puzzle where you must find the most devastating path, balancing destruction and strategy to scorch everything that dares stand before you.

Key Features

🔥 Be the Dragon – Again, and Mightier Than Ever
Command fire, wings, and fury across an expanding world of puzzles and devastation.

🧩 Strategic Destruction
Plan your routes carefully — the path of ruin is both a test of intellect and instinct.

🎥 Cinematic Camera System
A new dynamic perspective brings every flame, roar, and ruin to life in spectacular fashion.

📖 An Epic Continuation
The saga deepens: uncover the next chapter in a tale of vengeance, legend, and fire.
Told through handcrafted static scenes inspired by medieval chronicles, blending ancient storytelling with modern design.

🎨 Refined Visuals & Atmosphere
A minimalist yet powerful art style reborn — sharper, richer, and more immersive than ever.

🎵 Immersive Sound Design
Let the music and roars of the dragon echo through your bones as you shape your legend.

Gameplay Essence

Every level is a challenge of foresight and fury:

  • Trace your path of flames.

  • Burn enemy strongholds.

  • Master timing, terrain, and firepower.

  • Witness the world crumble beneath your wings.

Will you burn for vengeance — or for the sheer beauty of destruction?

data.short_description: The fire returns. The kingdoms still smolder from your last rampage… and now, the dragon awakens again. This time, your fury has evolved — sharper claws, brighter flames, and a story forged in vengeance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A simple mouse or touchpad recommended
